hints.title: Subtree Inversion Parity
hints.text: Determine how flipping signs at a node affects its entire downstream branch.

hints.title: Cooldown Tracking
hints.text: Inversion can only be applied when at least k steps have elapsed since the prior flip.

hints.title: Tree Recurrence
hints.text: Combine child returns under both active inversion states, choosing the maximum sum when cooldown is satisfied.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Memoized states track node, cooldown steps, and boolean parity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential branches arise when deciding independently at every node.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bounding cooldown at k keeps distinct memoized states to O(n * k).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Properly represent parity propagation down the tree structure.
